items.description: Symbol U2 Pin 39 [VSYS, Power input, Line]

reason: ACCEPTED: standalone sheet ERC excludes the cross-sheet supply/return. Root SYS has U1.1 driving U2.39, and root GND contains U1.5. These standalone findings disappear in root ERC; no declared endpoint is lost.

description: Pins of type Power output and Power output are connected

items.description: Symbol U2 Pin 3 [GND, Power output, Line]
Symbol U2 Pin 33 [AGND, Power output, Line]

reason: ACCEPTED: native symbol types mark U2.3 GND and U2.33 AGND as power_out. Declared circuit explicitly joins both to common GND. This is a pin-type conflict on declared ground, not fusion of two distinct supply nets; library/datasheet approval is not claimed.
